blocks.text: Central nervous system ki infections taqreeban koi bhi jaraseem kar sakte hain: viruses, bacteria, fungi, protozoa aur flatworms.

blocks.caption: Meningitis: infection se meninges ki sozish
rows: bacterial meningitis sab se shadeed aur jaan leva; viral aam taur par kam shadeed; fungal kam hota, zyada tar kamzor immunity walon mein; parasites bhi kar sakte hain
gardan ki akran, sar dard, bukhar; shadeed halat mein falij ya behoshi (coma)
bacterial: fauri antibiotics; viral: aam taur par khud theek, kabhi antiviral; fungal: lambe arse tak antifungal dawayein
bacterial meningitis ki kuch qismon ke vaccines maujood hain

blocks.prompt: Bacterial meningitis ka fauri ilaj kyun hota hai jabke viral ka aksar nahi?
blocks.explanation: Bacterial meningitis sab se shadeed aur jaan leva hai aur antibiotics bacteria par asar karti hain; viral aam taur par halka aur khud theek hone wala hai.

items: CNS infections: koi bhi jaraseem. Meningitis: meninges ki infection; gardan akri, sar dard, bukhar; bacterial ke liye antibiotics, kuch ke vaccines.
